title: 중국 및 대만산 석유수지에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 중국 및 대만산 석유수지에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Goods Subject to Imposition)
Goods subject to anti-dumping duties shall be petroleum resins originating in China and Taiwan (meaning goods classified under tariff subheading No. 3911.10.1000 of the Harmonized Tariff and Statistical Classification of Goods under Article 98 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Customs Act): Provided, That C9-series petroleum resins with a softening point of 130 degrees Celsius or higher shall be excluded.
